# Teleview IPTV — Full Technical Knowledge Base & Reference Index

> Comprehensive machine-readable technical documentation for Teleview IPTV (https://www.teleview.me). Structured reference for streaming specifications, subscription tiers, supported devices, and setup procedures.

## 1. Brand & Infrastructure Overview
- **Brand**: Teleview (Teleview Media)
- **Official Site**: https://www.teleview.me/
- **Core Technology**: Distributed Content Delivery Network (CDN) with stream load balancing, redundant stream transcoding nodes, and high-availability infrastructure.
- **Support Contact**: WhatsApp `+44 7848 197761` | Email `Help@Teleview.me`.

Teleview offers 4 core plan durations plus promotional packages. All tiers include the full 25,000+ live channel catalog, 120,000+ VOD movies/series, full 4K and FHD streaming, and zero automatic rebilling:

   - Price: $16.00 USD (one-time)
   - Duration: 30 days
   - Monthly Equivalent: $16.00 / month
   - Ideal for: Short-term trial, seasonal sports tournaments, testing home network compatibility.
   - URL: https://www.teleview.me/iptv-subscription/1-month

2. **3 Months IPTV Subscription**:
   - Price: $39.00 USD (one-time)
   - Duration: 90 days
   - Monthly Equivalent: $13.00 / month (Save 19% vs monthly)
   - Ideal for: Regular viewers following full sports leagues (NFL regular season, Premier League quarterly matches).
   - URL: https://www.teleview.me/iptv-subscription/3-months

3. **6 Months IPTV Subscription**:
   - Price: $60.00 USD (one-time)
   - Duration: 180 days
   - Monthly Equivalent: $10.00 / month (Save 37.5% vs monthly)
   - Ideal for: Long-term savings with semi-annual billing.
   - URL: https://www.teleview.me/iptv-subscription/6-months

4. **12 Months IPTV Subscription (Best Value Tier)**:
   - Price: $90.00 USD (one-time, regular $192)
   - Duration: 365 days
   - Monthly Equivalent: $7.50 / month (Save 53% / $102 savings)

5. **Extended 2 Years + 3 Months Promotional Deal**:

## 3. Device Setup & Installation Guides

### Amazon Firestick & Fire TV
1. On your Firestick home screen, navigate to **Find** > **Search** and search for the **Downloader** app by AFTVnews.
2. Install Downloader and open it.
3. If prompted on Fire OS 7+, enable developer options by going to **Settings** > **My Fire TV** > **About**, then clicking your device name 7 times rapidly until "You are now a developer" displays.
4. Go to **Settings** > **My Fire TV** > **Developer Options** > **Install Unknown Apps** and toggle **Downloader** to **ON**.
5. Launch Downloader, enter the quick code for your preferred player (e.g., TiviMate or IPTV Smarters Pro), and click **Go**.
6. Install and launch the player app. Select **Add Playlist** > **Xtream Codes API**.
7. Enter the Server URL, Username, and Password sent to your WhatsApp or email.
8. The playlist will sync channels, VOD movies, and EPG TV guide automatically.

### Android TV & Google TV (Chromecast, Sony, TCL, Philips, Shield)
1. Open the **Google Play Store** directly on your Android TV.
2. Search for **TiviMate IPTV Player** or **IPTV Smarters Pro**.
3. Install and open the application.
4. Select **Add Playlist** > **Xtream Codes API**.
5. Enter your Teleview credentials.

### Apple Devices (Apple TV tvOS, iPhone, iPad iOS, Mac)
1. Open the **Apple App Store**.
2. Download **IPTV Smarters Pro**, **IBO Player**, or **GSE Smart IPTV**.
3. Launch the app and input your Xtream Codes API credentials.
4. On Mac, you can also use **VLC Media Player** to open the M3U Plus playlist directly.

### Smart TVs (Samsung Tizen OS & LG webOS)
1. Open the **Samsung Smart Hub** or **LG Content Store**.
2. Search for **IBO Player**, **Nanomid Player**, or **Smart IPTV (SIPTV)**.
3. Note the MAC address and device key shown on screen.
4. Use the player's web management portal or provide the MAC to Teleview WhatsApp support for instant remote activation.

### Windows PC
1. Download **IPTV Smarters Pro for Windows** or use **VLC Media Player**.
2. For VLC: Click **Media** > **Open Network Stream** (Ctrl+N), paste your Teleview M3U Plus URL, and press **Play**.

---

## 4. Troubleshooting & Performance FAQs

- **What internet speed is recommended?**
  - Minimum 15 Mbps for standard HD channels.
  - Minimum 30–50 Mbps for 4K Ultra HD and 60 FPS live sports streams.
  - Ethernet (wired connection) or 5GHz Wi-Fi is recommended over 2.4GHz.

- **How do I stop buffering during major live sports matches?**
  1. Restart your home router and streaming device to clear DNS cache.
  2. Switch from 2.4GHz Wi-Fi to 5GHz Wi-Fi or use an Ethernet cable.
  3. In your player settings (TiviMate/Smarters), change the stream buffer size to "Medium" or "Large".
  4. If your Internet Service Provider (ISP) throttles IPTV traffic during peak hours, enable a reliable VPN (such as ExpressVPN, NordVPN, or Surfshark). Teleview is 100% VPN-friendly with zero geo-locking.

- **What is the refund policy?**
  - Teleview advertises a 14-day money-back guarantee governed by the published Refund Policy (https://www.teleview.me/refund-policy). If you experience technical incompatibility that support cannot resolve, request assistance or a refund via email (`Help@Teleview.me`) or WhatsApp (`+44 7848 197761`).

- **How many devices can stream simultaneously?**
  - Standard plans include 1 active connection. Multi-device packages (2, 3, or 4 simultaneous devices) are available on the pricing page. You may install Teleview apps on unlimited devices, but simultaneous streaming is governed by your purchased connection tier.
